description: Who is assigned to which project or task, with role, rate and budget. With user_id: that user's active assignments incl. time and money budgets (GET /api/v3/users/{userId}/assignments). With project_id: all assignments of the project (GET /api/v4/projects/{projectId}/assignments). Otherwise a filtered list of team (TSG…) and user (ASG…) assignments (GET /api/v5/assignments, e.g. filter 'active$eq:true$and:client_name$like:*Beispiel*'). include_team_created: also list user assignments created from a team assignment (default false). Read-only.
name: list_ehour_assignments
